ambiguity_notes: Spec says 'release of reset is synchronous to clk' but also says reset is asynchronous active-low; interpreted as: deassertion of rst_n takes effect on the next rising clock edge (synchronous release), while assertion of rst_n takes effect immediately (asynchronous assert)
Spec says done clears when 'load_en high' in DONE state; assumed this means on the first rising clock edge where load_en is observed high while in DONE state, done clears and the FSM returns to LOAD
The spec does not explicitly state whether load_cnt and round are cleared by reset; assumed both are cleared to 0 on reset
The spec does not state what happens if shift_out_en is asserted before done is high; assumed shift_out_en is ignored (dout=0) when done is not asserted
The spec does not state what happens if load_en and shift_out_en are simultaneously asserted in DONE state; assumed load_en takes priority and initiates a new load cycle
The spec says 'shift state left each edge' during unload but does not specify what is shifted into state[0]; assumed 0 is shifted in
The spec does not define the initial value of state, key_reg, or round after reset beyond what is implied by FSM returning to LOAD; assumed all registers are cleared to 0 on reset

The spec does not explicitly state whether unload_cnt is used to automatically de-assert done after 64 bits are shifted out; assumed done remains asserted indefinitely until reset or load_en, and the host is responsible for counting 64 output bits

The addRoundKey step within each of the 31 rounds uses key_reg[79:16] before the key schedule update for that round; the final addRoundKey after round 31 uses key_reg[79:16] after the round-31 key schedule update; this ordering is inferred from standard PRESENT-80 specification

The spec lists unload_cnt[5:0] as an internal register but does not describe its precise use; assumed it counts bits shifted out during unload for potential future use or debugging, but does not gate done
The S-box lookup index x is the 4-bit nibble value of the state nibble being substituted, not the nibble position index; SBOX[4*x +: 4] extracts the 4-bit output for input nibble value x

behavior_invariants.condition: On every rising clock edge where load_en is high and the FSM is in LOAD state, the 144-bit shift register {key_reg[79:0], state[63:0]} shifts left by one bit and din is inserted at bit position 0; the first bit received becomes key_reg[79] (MSB of key) and the 144th bit received becomes state[0] (LSB of plaintext)
behavior_invariants.description: During LOAD phase, each rising edge with load_en high shifts one bit MSB-first into the concatenated {key_reg, state} register
behavior_invariants.name: load_shift_order

behavior_invariants.condition: When load_cnt reaches 144 on a rising edge with load_en high, the FSM transitions from LOAD to ENCRYPT on that same edge without requiring any additional control signal; round counter is initialised to 1
behavior_invariants.description: Encryption begins automatically on the clock edge that accepts the 144th serial bit
behavior_invariants.name: encrypt_auto_start

behavior_invariants.condition: On each rising edge in ENCRYPT state (rounds 1 through 31), the following operations are applied in order: (1) XOR state with the upper 64 bits of key_reg (key_reg[79:16]); (2) apply 4-bit S-box substitution to each of the 16 nibbles of state using SBOX=64'h21748FE3DA09B65C; (3) apply pLayer permutation where output bit P(i) receives input bit i, with P(i)=(i*16) mod 63 for i=0..62 and P(63)=63; (4) update key_reg by rotating left 61 bits, applying S-box to the top nibble, and XORing the current round counter into bits [19:15] of key_reg
behavior_invariants.description: Each encryption round applies addRoundKey, sBoxLayer, pLayer, and key schedule update in one clock edge
behavior_invariants.name: encrypt_round_sequence

behavior_invariants.condition: On the clock edge immediately following the 31st round edge in ENCRYPT state, state is XORed with key_reg[79:16] (using the key_reg value after the round-31 key schedule update), done is set to 1, and the FSM transitions to DONE state
behavior_invariants.description: After round 31 key schedule update, one additional edge applies the final addRoundKey and asserts done
behavior_invariants.name: final_addroundkey

behavior_invariants.condition: Once done is asserted, it remains high on every subsequent rising edge unless rst_n is deasserted (asynchronous clear) or load_en goes high (synchronous clear on the rising edge where load_en is first seen high in DONE state)
behavior_invariants.description: done remains asserted until reset or a new load begins
behavior_invariants.name: done_held

behavior_invariants.condition: In DONE state, dout equals state[63] when shift_out_en is high; dout equals 0 when shift_out_en is low or done is not asserted; on each rising edge where shift_out_en is high and done is asserted, state shifts left by one bit (state[0] receives 0)
behavior_invariants.description: dout reflects state[63] only when shift_out_en is high and done is asserted
behavior_invariants.name: dout_during_unload

behavior_invariants.condition: Whenever the FSM is not in DONE state, or when in DONE state but shift_out_en is low, dout must be 0
behavior_invariants.description: dout is driven to 0 in all phases except active unload
behavior_invariants.name: dout_zero_outside_unload

behavior_invariants.condition: Whenever rst_n transitions to 0, regardless of clock edge, done is immediately cleared to 0, the FSM returns to LOAD/IDLE state, load_cnt is cleared to 0, and any in-progress encryption is abandoned; this effect is not gated by the clock
behavior_invariants.description: Asynchronous active-low reset immediately clears done and returns FSM to LOAD/IDLE
behavior_invariants.name: async_reset_effect

behavior_invariants.condition: Given key=0x00000000000000000000 and plaintext=0x0000000000000000, ciphertext must be 0x5579C1387B228445; given key=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF and plaintext=0x0000000000000000, ciphertext must be 0xE72C46C0F5945049; given key=0x00000000000000000000 and plaintext=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, ciphertext must be 0xA112FFC72F68417B; given key=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF and plaintext=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, ciphertext must be 0x3333DCD3213210D2
behavior_invariants.description: The module must produce correct ciphertext for all four acceptance test vectors
behavior_invariants.name: test_vector_correctness

behavior_invariants.condition: load_cnt starts at 0 after reset; it increments by 1 on each rising edge where load_en is high and the FSM is in LOAD state; when load_cnt reaches 144, the ENCRYPT phase begins and load_cnt is no longer incremented
behavior_invariants.description: load_cnt increments by one for each bit shifted in during LOAD phase
behavior_invariants.name: load_cnt_tracking

behavior_invariants.condition: At the start of ENCRYPT, round is set to 1; it increments by 1 on each rising edge in ENCRYPT state; after round 31 completes, the final addRoundKey edge executes and the FSM moves to DONE; round never exceeds 31 during normal operation
behavior_invariants.description: The round counter runs from 1 to 31 inclusive during ENCRYPT phase
behavior_invariants.name: round_counter_range

behavior_invariants.condition: During key schedule update, the 80-bit key_reg is rotated left by 61 positions, meaning key_reg[(79-61):0] becomes the new key_reg[79:19] and key_reg[79:(80-61)] becomes the new key_reg[18:0]; equivalently this is a right rotation by 19 bits
behavior_invariants.description: Key schedule rotation is a left rotation by 61 bits (equivalently right rotation by 19 bits)
behavior_invariants.name: key_schedule_rotate_left_61

clock_domains.name: clk
clock_domains.notes: Single clock domain; all registers are rising-edge triggered on clk; reset is asynchronous

encoding.key_schedule_sbox_target: top nibble of key_reg after rotation (bits [79:76])
encoding.sbox_lookup: SBOX[4*x +: 4] for nibble index x in 0..15
encoding.serial_input_order: MSB-first; key[79] arrives first, plaintext[63] arrives 81st, plaintext[0] arrives 144th
encoding.serial_output_order: MSB-first; state[63] is first bit shifted out

port_assumptions.notes: Rising-edge triggered; target frequency 100 MHz (10 ns period)
Asynchronous active-low reset; 0 asserts reset immediately regardless of clock
Must be held high for exactly 144 consecutive rising edges to complete loading; assumed not asserted simultaneously with shift_out_en during normal operation
Valid only when load_en is high; first 80 bits are key MSB-first, next 64 bits are plaintext MSB-first
Meaningful only when done is asserted; ignored in LOAD and ENCRYPT phases
Outputs state[63] MSB-first when shift_out_en and done are both high; 0 otherwise
Registered output; asserted exactly one clock after the 32nd ENCRYPT edge (31 rounds + final addRoundKey)
